Author: yjohnson-dev
Name: Blackout
Punchline: Turns the screen black while you are away or the game is in the background.
Description: Fades the screen to black when the game is in the background or when you are away. You can change the behavior for duties, crafting, and other situations. A timer shows that the game is still running. This plugin helps to prevent burn-in on OLED monitors.
